title: Kamishiro Rui — Brand New Style〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Shopping Mall

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Now then...
I got what I wanted, so it's time to head home.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Still, I feel very fortunate that this shopping mall was carrying what I was looking for.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Shopping mall bookstores tend to carry a lot of stuff related to the entertainment industry, but to think I'd find something so technical...)
Huh? Rui?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, what a coincidence.
Are you also on your way home, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I just finished meeting everyone on my committee. I needed a quick break, so I decided to take a little detour...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The bag you're carrying is from the bookstore in the mall, right? What did you buy?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, it's the translated version of a book from abroad about directing.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Whoa, it's as thick as a dictionary! And the print's tiny...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Translations of this kind of book always end up having the most difficult sentences. I'd have a lot of trouble getting through it...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But you've just breezed through them since we were little...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
It's not that I breezed through them...
I've experienced enough of them now that they feel familiar.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In particular, when it came to mechanical engineering, books from overseas typically taught me the most.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, you did used to read a lot of books on machines and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I feel that you've been reading more books about directing lately...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's because the current me needs to know more about both directing and inventing.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Naturally, I still put effort into making anything that supports my directing, but I've started prioritizing learning recently...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The more I know about past events and various technologies, the more options I'll have when faced with similar concepts in show business.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This past year helped me realize that.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I think I know what you mean.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You've also been reading quite a bit lately, right?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Seiryuin said that she always reads books during a show's rehearsal process so that she can better understand her character and the background of the story.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I never really put that level of effort in before, but now I have no choice but to follow her example...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
That's wonderful to hear.
However...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It moves me to see how the girl who spent all her time reading picture books has moved on to more difficult texts.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Picture books? How far back in time are you going...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm a high schooler now. It's normal for me to read difficult books.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, you're right.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Still...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We've both come such a long way...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Rui...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Remember how we used to play a lot and share books with each other?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We were both so enthralled by that rendition of The Little Mermaid that we couldn't stop talking about it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We even tried making our own shows together... You acted and I directed.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Looking back, it was a bit similar to playing house...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But now, we're finally pursuing our dreams from back them.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: How incredible is that?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It is...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The shows we did back then only involved the two of us...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But now our numbers have grown.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes.
This past year ended up being a momentous turning point for us.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But the climax of the show that is our lives is still yet to come.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: On that day, I hope we'll be able to shine as brightly as possible. I'm looking forward to experiencing it together with you.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I don't know what you're going on about...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Still...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Whatever it is, I hope so too.
Let's go make our dreams come true.
